Helmert sub-matrix

Source: R/geometry.R
helmert_submatrix.Rd

Returns the (k-1) x k Helmert sub-matrix used to remove translation from a landmark configuration.

Usage

helmert_submatrix(k)

Arguments

k

Integer. Number of landmarks (>= 2).

Value

A real matrix of size (k-1) x k.

Details

The full Helmert matrix \(H^F\) is the k x k orthogonal matrix with first row \((1/\sqrt{k}, \dots, 1/\sqrt{k})\) and, for \(j \ge 2\), jth row \((-1, \dots, -1, j-1, 0, \dots, 0)/\sqrt{j(j-1)}\) where the entry \(j-1\) occurs at column \(j\). Dropping the first row yields the Helmert sub-matrix \(H\).

Applying \(H\) to a configuration removes translation, and \(H^\top H = I_k - k^{-1} \mathbf{1}_k \mathbf{1}_k^\top\) is the centring matrix – so \(H\) is the orthonormal representation of centring.

Examples

H <- helmert_submatrix(4)
# Rows are orthonormal:
round(H %*% t(H), 12)
#>      [,1] [,2] [,3]
#> [1,]    1    0    0
#> [2,]    0    1    0
#> [3,]    0    0    1
